title: Butter Converter (Sticks, Cups, Grams, Tbsp)
metaDescription: Convert butter measurements between US sticks, cups, tablespoons, grams, and ounces with international butter block conversions.
directAnswer: In US baking, 1 stick of butter equals one-half cup, 8 tablespoons, 4 ounces, or 113.4 grams. Two sticks equal 1 full cup (226.8 grams). European butter blocks typically weigh 250 grams, which corresponds to approximately 1.1 cups or 2.2 US butter sticks with higher milkfat content.

faq.question: How much is 1 stick of butter in grams?
faq.answer: 1 US stick of butter equals 113.4 grams (1/2 cup or 8 tablespoons).

faq.question: How do I substitute European butter for American butter?
faq.answer: European butter (like Kerrygold or President) has 82%+ butterfat compared to American 80%. You can substitute 1:1 by weight (grams) for richer pastries.

faq.question: How many tablespoons of butter is 100 grams?
faq.answer: 100 grams of butter equals approximately 7 tablespoons (or 0.88 US sticks).
